title: Lead Error Manager
description:
What's the role?:  

As a Lead Error Manager will own and continuously improve our end\-to\-end software error and defect management framework. This role combines operational leadership across multiple projects with process governance, Jira\-based workflow and template ownership, reporting, and integration with external service and defect management systems. You will define the business and process requirements for workflows, fields, templates, dashboards and integrations. Platform\-level configuration and changes will be assessed, approved and implemented in collaboration with the responsible IT, Jira administration, security and product teams. This is not a Jira system administrator position.  

* Own and continuously improve the complete defect lifecycle, from intake, classification and prioritisation through assignment, resolution, verification and closure.
* Own the functional definition and governance of common Jira\-based error management templates, including workflows, issue types, fields, screens, statuses, transition rules and reporting requirements.
* Own the business process and functional mapping between Jira and connected third\-party defect, customer support and enterprise service management systems, including ServiceNow where applicable.
* Define operational KPIs, SLA requirements, dashboards and management reporting for defect flows and process health.
* Act as the central point of contact and escalation for error management process and tooling topics.
* Be accountable for the functional design, governance and continuous improvement of the common error management process and associated Jira templates used company\-wide.


Who are you?:  

You are a fast learner, with an eye for detail, strong problem\-solving and debugging skills. In addition you have the following qualifications:  

* BS or MS in Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
* 7 to 10 years of overall industry expereicne including 5\+ year experience in software \& content error management, defect management, quality management or a comparable process leadership role in a complex software \& content environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing defect lifecycles across multiple products, projects or organizational teams.
* Strong practical knowledge of Jira Cloud workflows, issue types, fields, screens, permissions, dashboards and reporting from a process\-owner or advanced business\-administration perspective.
* Experience defining and governing common workflows and templates in collaboration with Jira administrators and IT teams.
* Experience with integrations between Jira and external defect, support or enterprise service management systems, such as ServiceNow.
* Experience defining field, status, workflow and data synchronisation mappings between systems.
* Strong understanding of defect triage, severity and priority classification, backlog management, escalation, verification and closure practices.
* Experience defining KPIs, SLAs, dashboards and management reporting for defect or operational processes.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional alignment and influence stakeholders without relying on direct line authority.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

We will support you in delivering your day\-to\-day tasks and achieving your personal goals and developing your skills. Personal development is highly encouraged at HERE. HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.  


Who are we?:

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.

* Explain the payment terms \& conditions.

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
**Position:** Senior System Administrator  
**Experience:** 5–6 Years  
**Company:** Satyajeet India Enterprises Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Role**

Satyajeet India Enterprises Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **Senior System Administrator** to manage and maintain the organization’s IT infrastructure, servers, storage systems, network security, and wireless technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in Windows environments, hardware servers, NAS/SAN storage, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, monitor, and maintain **hardware servers and IT infrastructure**.
* Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain **Windows Server environments**.
* Manage and maintain **NAS and SAN storage systems**, including storage allocation, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot **firewalls and network security systems**.
* Manage and maintain **wireless networks and related infrastructure**.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, server, storage, network, and connectivity issues.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and overall infrastructure health.
* Perform regular system maintenance, updates, backups, and security checks.
* Ensure proper configuration and availability of critical IT infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for hardware, networking, and infrastructure\-related issues.
* Maintain proper documentation of servers, network devices, storage, configurations, and IT assets.
* Ensure compliance with organizational IT security and infrastructure policies.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **5–6 years of relevant experience** in System Administration / IT Infrastructure.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Windows Server Administration**.
* Good understanding of **hardware servers and server infrastructure**.
* Practical knowledge of **NAS and SAN storage technologies**.
* Good knowledge of **Firewall configuration and management**.
* Strong understanding of **Wireless Networking Technologies**.
* Good knowledge of networking fundamentals such as **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, VLANs**, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently handle IT infrastructure and resolve technical issues.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with enterprise\-level IT infrastructure.
* Knowledge of server backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Familiarity with virtualization technologies.
* Knowledge of network monitoring and security tools.
* Relevant certifications such as **MCSE, MCSA, CCNA, or equivalent** will be an added advantage.

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong professional who can take ownership of the organization’s IT infrastructure and ensure **high availability, security, performance, and reliability** of systems and networks.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

**sagar@satyajeetindia.com**

Pay: From ₹500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
